description: Proposed 6 Metre Single-Storey Rear Extension and Conversion of Garage into Habitable Space
decision_conditions: The proposed extension, by reason of its depth, height and proximity to the shared boundaries with nos. 156 and 158A Ardleigh Green Road, would give rise to an overbearing, intrusive and unneighbourly development that would have an adverse impact on the amenity of these adjoining occupiers, contrary to Local Plan Policy 7 and the Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, notification of intended refusal and the reason for it was given to the agent via email on 01/10/2026.

Were this application to be the subject of an appeal, the Inspector should note that the submitted block plans do not accurately depict the relationship between the application site and no. 158A Ardleigh Green Road.

The Local Planning Authority has acted positively and proactively in determining this application by assessing the proposal against all material planning considerations, including planning policies and any representations which were received.  It subsequently determined to grant planning permission in accordance with the National Planning Policy requirement that applications for sustainable development are approved where possible.  A detailed analysis of the scheme is set out in the report on the application prepared by officers.
